reserveReview.rationale: Pinned re-verification on 2026-11-20 reproduced the original 2026-10-27 issuer-reported denominator. The Morpho Core adapter held 34,797.7236130591 shares convertible to 34,939.6221153417 USDU. The Curve adapter held 22,651.3315938697 shares out of 50,012.3898532764. Multiplying by the pool virtual price 1.001571384277983263 reproduces the issuer's 22,686.9255402117 USDU-equivalent LP amount. Allocate that carrying value by the pool balances of 40,176.2393622052 USDU and 9,929.076831 USDC. That yields 18,191.1904792984 USDU-equivalent of own exposure. TermMax Core and RWA convert to 0.000000000512067650 and 0.000000000001 USDU. Yield held zero vault shares. The derived total of 57,626.5476555539 agrees with the issuer's 57,626.54765566666 within 0.000001 USDU. The October 27 observation sets the date of the scoped book. The November 20 review establishes the revised scope and TermMax classification.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Historical issuer Morpho, Curve and TermMax backing denominator, reproduced by Ethereum block 26282914 (2026-10-27T08:41:47Z).
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The denominator covers the issuer's dated Morpho Core, USDC/USDU Curve and TermMax report only. The token supply at the same block was 257,635.9173632263 USDU. The separate CurveSeed module had 200,000 USDU of combined debt in USDU/EURU and USDU/CHFU LPs. The two swap bridges held 12.497327 USDC and 1.005377 USDT in Morpho vaults. Their values do not reconcile into the reported denominator, so no composition share or own-liability mark is assigned to them. This is a dated reserve report and does not establish current or full-supply backing.
